subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant thread status show sanitized per-tool progress, or remain generic while loading messages, draft previews, reactions, and task cards carry tool visibility?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the best behavior depends on Slack UX, duplicate-progress avoidance, and disclosure policy rather than a narrow broken-code repair.

options.title: Defer Behind Visibility Policy
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide it together with the Slack-safe progress visibility policy before adding native per-tool labels.

options.title: Implement Sanitized Native Status
options.body: Add per-tool native status updates using shared sanitized progress labels, with no raw args/paths, clear/dedupe behavior, focused tests, and live Slack proof.

options.title: Keep Native Status Generic
options.body: Document that Slack native status stays generic and tool visibility belongs only in loading messages, draft previews, reactions, or task cards.

recommendation.title: Defer Behind Visibility Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide it together with the Slack-safe progress visibility policy before adding native per-tool labels.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete most recently changed the same Slack native status default and docs in PR 100462, so he is the best available owner for the product-direction choice.
